2.284.19
CustomReportItem.Visibility
The CustomReportItem.Visibility element specifies the presentational presence of a
CustomReportItem element. The CustomReportItem.Visibility element is optional and MUST NOT
be specified more than once. If this element is present, it is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the CustomReportItem.Visibility element.
Parent elements
CustomReportItem
The following is the XML Schema definition of the CustomReportItem.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
